name: Elai.io
tagline: Elai.io is an AI video generation platform that turns text scripts into polished presenter videos using realistic AI avatars. You choose from dozens of avatars, write or paste your script, and get a professional-quality video in minutes — without cameras, studios, or recording. It's widely used for corporate training, onboarding, and multilingual marketing content.
